items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: But the lady who owned the label was Art Roupes.

ctx.x: No, the one that I remember him introducing me to. It wasn't the lady. I learned the lady was in charge of the whole thing after I did it. But the lady was more nicer than who I thought I was doing the session for, because he was sitting there getting kicks. Who did the session? The guy that was supposed to be in charge of the session, the guy that Mr. Joe Asanto put in charge of the session, rather, I think his name was Dick Surgeon. Dick Surgeon? Yeah. Dick Surgeon. Where's that name called?
But the lady who owned the label was Art Roupes. I think her name was. Leah. Leona. Leah. Leah or Leona? It was Leona or Leah Roup. She was very famous. I think she was divorced from art at the time.
Seems like she had feelings anyway.
